caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a three-dimensional, life-sized figure of a horse in mid-leap or gallop, positioned horizontally across a plain, light beige background. The horse is rendered in a golden-brown color, with areas of subtle shading to suggest muscle contours and depth. There are visible accents of purplish and bluish discolorations scattered across the horse’s body, particularly on the flank, upper leg, and tail area. The horse's mane and tail are stylized and windswept, featuring a slightly darker brown hue. The legs are outstretched in a running motion, and a vertical rod or post supports the horse’s belly, extending downward. In the lower right corner of the image, there is a signature that reads “CHAS.T. MAHERNOX.” No additional objects or elements appear in the background, which remains unadorned.
title: Galloping Horse Weather Vane
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
